rules.critical: contradictory or unsupported active answer key / terminology presented as authoritative

issues.reason: academic patterns are curriculum-derived and lack item-level external/curated authority
issues.disposition: UNVERIFIED until reviewed; do not auto-promote

issues.reason: large assessment bank requires item/source-bound answer-key authority; bulk semantic auto-fix forbidden
issues.disposition: validate incrementally with golden fixtures and source-backed review

note: Open review debt is not a claim of correctness. RU03 passes because authority is fail-closed and no unresolved item is allowed to masquerade as VERIFIED.
